title: Mallorca
description: Analogue photographs from Mallorca by Bart Mulder: rocky cliffs, shuttered windows and cars parked in the shade, all shot on film.

images.alt: A parked car covered with a silver car cover, next to a tree on a paved area, with a green trash bin and a streetlamp nearby, and trees in the background under a blue sky.
Close-up of a rocky cliff with green bushes and trees, clear blue sky in the background.
A beige wall with a window featuring open brown wooden shutters and a small balcony with a potted plant with bright red flowers.
